svg.title: Research Settings Without Conversion Claims
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-research-tool-benchmarks; chapter number: 6; title: Research Settings Without Conversion Claims; subtitle: Image quality, preservation access, planning size, and candidate similarity measure different things.; caption: Transkribus supplies the image recommendation; ScottishArchivesTV states the Fixity Pro trial period; Rebecca Coford supplies the planning examples; Johannes demonstrates the Neo4j similarity threshold.; assumptions note: Transkribus, ScottishArchivesTV, Rebecca Coford, and Johannes report independent measures with different units. These are not successive populations, and their widths do not establish attrition or conversion. Coford's five and ten are alternative plan sizes, not a measured reduction.; note: Johannes calls 0.20 unusually low for the Neo4j demonstration. ScottishArchivesTV's trial duration is a tutorial-era product statement, not a research deadline.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Recognition image resolution; value: 300; display: 300 DPI JPEGs; conversion: Not a conversion measure; detail: Transkribus recommends 300 DPI JPEGs in its introductory tutorial while also accepting PNGs and PDFs.; label: Preservation trial period; value: 30; display: First 30 days free; conversion: Not a conversion measure; detail: ScottishArchivesTV states this Fixity Pro trial period while demonstrating repeated checksum scans.; label: Initial plan with ten ideas; value: 10; display: 10 research ideas; conversion: Alternative planning example; detail: Rebecca Coford describes a simple initial plan as five or ten ideas because plans evolve.; label: Initial plan with five ideas; value: 5; display: 5 research ideas; conversion: Alternative planning example; detail: Rebecca Coford emphasizes choosing records that answer the research question, whether online or offline.; label: Candidate similarity threshold; value: 0.2; display: 0.20 demonstration threshold; conversion: Not an identity-confirmation rate; detail: Johannes applies this threshold after multiplying structural similarity by embedding cosine similarity in the Neo4j example.

rect.title: label: Recognition image resolution; value: 300; display: 300 DPI JPEGs; conversion: Not a conversion measure; detail: Transkribus recommends 300 DPI JPEGs in its introductory tutorial while also accepting PNGs and PDFs.

label: Initial plan with ten ideas; value: 10; display: 10 research ideas; conversion: Alternative planning example; detail: Rebecca Coford describes a simple initial plan as five or ten ideas because plans evolve.

label: Initial plan with five ideas; value: 5; display: 5 research ideas; conversion: Alternative planning example; detail: Rebecca Coford emphasizes choosing records that answer the research question, whether online or offline.

label: Candidate similarity threshold; value: 0.2; display: 0.20 demonstration threshold; conversion: Not an identity-confirmation rate; detail: Johannes applies this threshold after multiplying structural similarity by embedding cosine similarity in the Neo4j example.
